method: Freshly rendered all four latest PDFs with pdftoppm -r 100 -png after the final internship-summary copy repair, then visually inspected all six pages: English academic 1–2, English internship 1, Chinese academic 1–2, Chinese internship 1. Both internship versions now name networks that infer directly from measurements. Existing font sizes, leading, section placement, page counts and content bounds are unchanged. Checked fonts and missing glyphs, line breaks and spacing, clipping and overlap, section transitions, Chinese photo clearance, and page numbers. Actual PDF text, nine publications in each academic version, photo counts and page counts passed through Poppler/pypdf. Both public PDFs rebuilt byte-identically. The frozen profile SHA-256 and mtime remained unchanged during this repair.
html_visual_qa: Not separately reviewed; HTML CVs are unlinked companions of the reviewed PDFs.
